cc.t1: Run Q1, Q2 and Q3 as three subagents in parallel (the Agent tool, three calls in one message), then Q4 as a fourth subagent (Agent tool) that you give their three answers to.
cc.t2: Fix them with three subagents in parallel, one per file (the Agent tool, three calls in one message).
cc.t3: Use the Agent tool for the writer and for the reviewer, and relay the reviewer's findings to the writer yourself (continue the same writer agent with SendMessage if you can).

cursor.t1: Run Q1, Q2 and Q3 as three subagents in parallel (the Task tool, three calls in one message), then Q4 as a fourth subagent (Task tool) that you give their three answers to.
cursor.t2: Fix them with three subagents in parallel, one per file (the Task tool, three calls in one message).
cursor.t3: Use the Task tool for the writer and for the reviewer, and relay the reviewer's findings to the writer yourself.

hermes.t1: Run Q1, Q2 and Q3 as subagents in parallel with ONE delegate_task call that has a batch of three tasks, then Q4 as a second delegate_task call whose context contains their three answers.
hermes.t2: Fix them with subagents in parallel: ONE delegate_task call with a batch of three tasks, one per file.
hermes.t3: Use delegate_task for the writer and for the reviewer. Subagents cannot message each other, so relay the reviewer's findings to the writer yourself in a new delegate_task call.

volt.t1: Use Volt's delegate_task: ONE call with four tasks (model {{SUBMODEL}}): Q1, Q2 and Q3 run in parallel, and Q4 is the fourth task with after ["1","2","3"] so it gets their reports. Then wait for them.
volt.t2: Fix them with Volt's delegate_task: ONE call with three tasks run in parallel (model {{SUBMODEL}}, role implementation), one per file. Then wait for them.
volt.t3: Use Volt's delegate_task for the writer and for the reviewer (model {{SUBMODEL}}). Send the reviewer's findings to the writer task with message_task; start each re-review with delegate_task and previous_task_id.
